input.content: P0 pattern (saved-destinations repo, reader.py): removing the legacy-shape read fallback (top-level `address` vs nested `destination.address`) while background `migrate_batch` is still incremental. README contract: reads must handle both shapes until migration finishes; no startup migration gate; data/records.json is a supported mixed snapshot. Removing the fallback makes api.list_destinations raise KeyError for the whole list on any unmigrated row. Tests only cover new-shape writes, so the suite stays green. Rule: dual-read (expand/contract) code can only be removed after verifying zero legacy rows remain AND the mixed fixture is retired. Add a legacy-row regression test.
